name: PIXIU
description: PIXIU is a comprehensive financial AI framework including the first financial LLM fine-tuned with a large instruction dataset, and a standardized benchmark covering 8 tasks and 15 datasets across financial NLP and prediction tasks to evaluate financial LLMs.
reputation: PIXIU is one of the better-known open financial LLM benchmark suites and is frequently referenced in financial NLP and finance-oriented model evaluations.
notes: Includes instruction tuning dataset and evaluation benchmark for financial tasks; open-sourced.
